name: Natural Turn (backward half)
notes: Lead LF back, RF side, LF close while turning right; follow RF forward, LF side, RF close. Interprets the owner's left-foot/right-turn request as counts 4–6 of a Natural Turn, not a Reverse Turn. Reference pattern and usual three-eighths turn: https://www.ballroomdancers.com/Dances/info.asp?sid=128 and https://dance.djurredeboer.nl/standard/waltz/natural_turn.html . Total turn, travel dimensions, and body split 15/95/25 degrees are provisional for owner review. Count 1 opens a modest passing lane; count 2 places both feet for the final 135-degree closed stance, with feet pointing 25 degrees ahead of the bodies. The follow's pelvis remains 4 cm towards the previous support to keep the outside stride within normal reach. Explicit separate closing steps complete the body turn and reset shaping. Both count-2 arcs depart at floor heading 150 degrees, passing clear of standing legs. Rise is 2/4/0 cm, with late lowering and late closing weight. The existing quarter-turn flat Box Turn (backward half) is unchanged. All authoring and body checks remain active; dense footprint and full thigh/shin capsule regressions cover authored and placed playback.
